target: Application shell, footer loading layout, and Google sign-in control

contract.purpose: Keep discovery and planning usable while routes load or contain little content.
contract.canonicalPurpose: Anime List helps anime and manga fans find suitable titles and plan what to watch by combining a quality-gated MAL catalog with multi-field filters, schedules, and personal watchlists.
contract.audience: Anime and manga fans scanning the catalog, schedule, and personal planning surfaces.
contract.job: Move through catalog and schedule states without the footer fragmenting the shell, then recognize the optional account action without visual noise.
contract.thesis: Preserve the dark product system with a full-width footer boundary, tighter vertical rhythm, and a dark Google-auth treatment integrated into the header.
contract.system: Existing Tailwind tokens, four-pixel spacing scale, max-w-7xl content alignment, and responsive wrapping.
contract.signature: The compact two-line Anime List and Significant Hobbies lockup paired with live catalog recency.
contract.risk: The footer sits next to the studio band and the auth control retains third-party branding; compact spacing and Google's dark outlined pill keep both subordinate to the product.

ownerFeedback.note: The agent selected the direction; no owner approval was required.
